'''Zaboshka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who was known around [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk's]] [[Kashyyyk Royal City/Legends|Royal City]] as an informant of information to whoever paid enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was present at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Kashyyyk, where he met [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Jaylen Kos]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin's]] [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Padawan]].
